# CANDIDATE: BEARISH_REJECTION_VIX_CONFIRMATION_TIGHTEN

**Filed:** 2026-07-22  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** quality_gate  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON setup generates losing trades when VIX is insufficiently elevated or flat/falling, indicating lack of fear in the options market. By tightening the existing VIX confirmation rule to require VIX > 22 and a rising 5-bar slope, we aim to filter out low-quality bearish signals while preserving the three J anchor winners (which occurred during elevated VIX regimes).

## Mechanism

Add a pre-entry quality gate to BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON: at the trigger bar, require (1) VIX > 22.0 and (2) 5-bar VIX slope > 0 (computed as (VIX_current - VIX_5bars_ago) / 5). This gate is evaluated alongside existing context filters (time, structure, ribbon, news, volume, etc.). If VIX conditions fail, the setup is suppressed; otherwise, entry proceeds per standard rules (chart-stop primary, chandelier profit-lock, TP1 at +50%, etc.).

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+ account; $1K paper account ~= 14% headline P&L (based on 50% risk cap and ITM-2 0DTE premium ~$1.00).
2. **Sample bias:** Proposed rule based on manual inspection of J anchor days (4/29 VIX~24.5 rising, 5/01 VIX~21.8 rising, 5/04 VIX~28.3 rising; loser days 5/05 VIX~19.2 flat, 5/06 VIX~18.7 falling, 5/07 VIX~16.9 falling). High overfit risk due to small sample (n=6) and potential curve-fitting to VIX levels.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (walk-forward held-out window not yet performed).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (top 3 J day validation vs BS-sim not yet performed).
5. **Failure modes:** 
   - Worst day: If VIX spikes >30 on a loser day (e.g., 5/05), gate may suppress a winning reversal trade (unlikely but possible).
   - Max drawdown: Tightening may reduce trade frequency, increasing idle capital risk during ranging markets.
   - Blow-up scenario: Persistent VIX >22 with false breakdowns (e.g., 2025-Q3) could cause consecutive losses if ribbon-ride fails despite elevated fear.
6. **Concentration:** If top-5 days = X% of P&L, state X: unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest (historical concentration for BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON is ~60% based on leaderboard notes; tightening may alter concentration).

## Pre-merge gate

- Gym validators: All core strategy tests must pass (e.g., `test_bearish_rejection_ride_the_ribbon.py`).
- Walk-forward: OOS/IS Sharpe ratio ≥ 0.70 on 16-month data.
- Real-fills: Top 3 J days must show <±20% difference from BS-simulated P&L.
- Anchor no-regression: Must not reduce edge_capture on 4/29, 5/01, 5/04 winners by more than $50 each.
- Concentration check: Top-5 days ≤ 200% of P&L (to avoid extreme tail dependence).
